Onsite. Fast. Bold.

Blaze — Onsite. Fast. Bold. brings onsite registration, badge printing, session attendance, CEU tracking, access control and item fulfillment into one connected event experience. Talk to us about Blaze

ONSITE SERVICES

Six onsite services, one connected event experience. Blaze helps your team welcome people, track participation, and manage what each attendee can access or collect.

01

Scan. Print. Welcome.

Scan an attendee’s QR code, retrieve their registration, and print their badge in one focused workflow.

02

Register right at the venue

Onsite registration supports walk-ups and last-minute arrivals, so your team can help people register and get ready for the event at the desk.

03

Know who attended each session

Scan attendees as they enter a speaker session or class to record participation and give organizers a clearer attendance record.

04

Track attendance toward CEU credits

Help associations track attendance against their CEU requirements. The association sets the credit rules; attendance tracking does not itself provide accreditation or guarantee certification.

05

Check access at the door

Scan a badge at a controlled area and display granted or denied according to that attendee’s permissions, helping staff make consistent entry decisions.

06

Fulfill items once, with confidence

Scan a badge to see remaining item entitlements. If an attendee has three show bags remaining, staff can hand out all three and record fulfillment. A repeat scan shows those bags as already fulfilled and prevents duplicate pickup.
